question:
Select the most appropriate degree of comparison to fill in the blank.

Many ornithologists believe that the northern mocking birds are ________ wild birds in the jungle.
solution:
```html
The correct answer is '**the noisiest**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The superlative degree is used to compare more than two things or people.
 
• In this case, the superlative form "**the noisiest**" is used to indicate that northern mockingbirds are the most noisy among all wild birds in the jungle.
